info.title: Proxima Public API
info.description: Versioned HTTP surface for **Canonical exercises**, **Custom exercises**, and history-only **Workouts**. GET /api/v1/exercises is world-readable. Writes use a **Proxima API key** (`Authorization: Bearer`).

proximaApiKey.description: Proxima API key minted once in account settings. Optional on GET /api/v1/exercises; required on writes.
